# Version 4.152.0
> **Skia m152 platform release** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU bindings, asynchronous pixel reads, and the Skia m152 engine update. This release also fixes native lifetime bugs, adds Vulkan Silk.NET support, and improves Android, Apple, Windows, and containerized deployment.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m152** — Updates the bundled renderer through the m152 servicing and GlyphData fixes. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808), [#4925](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4925))

## API Surface

- **Graphite and asynchronous pixel read APIs** — Adds Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, plus backend-neutral asynchronous RequestReadPixels APIs on images and surfaces. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968), [#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **Vulkan Silk.NET package restored** — The Vulkan Silk.NET integration package is available again for supported Vulkan applications. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4841))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native lifetime issues fixed** — Fixes use-after-free and leak paths in SKRegion iteration, SKPixmap subsets, SKImage raster creation, and stream conversion to HarfBuzz blobs. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558), [#4710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4710))
- **Runtime effect and text APIs avoid unnecessary work** — Disposes replaced uniform buffers and reduces allocations in data saving, encoded text retrieval, tags, and HarfBuzz shaping. ([#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4690](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4690), [#4752](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4752))

## Platform

- **Native diagnostics and deployment support improved** — Apple symbol packages are generated during packing, Android symbol identity is deterministic, Nano Server uses FreeType, and Windows native builds initialize MSVC once. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska), [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche) ([#4846](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4846), [#4843](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4843), [#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280), [#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200

Improves HarfBuzzSharp stream ownership, shaping input performance, and tag formatting.
